what: One wet glass film over the board — a 44×44 cell film is pressed concave by three points trailing the cursor (.5·.18·.1 of the remaining distance per frame, weights 1·.5·.24) (radius 22% of screen height, depth 18%, edge bulging by .34) and wobbles back with a spring (pull .055 · damping .9). While pressed it dents 1.45x deeper and the film gets thinner and clearer (thickness .34→.18, roughness .07→.02, more so the faster the cursor moves). The film refracts (index 1.34) the images · video · canvas inside the board (or skin-color sky and white blobs if there are none), blurred (roughness +.1 blur), and splits red and blue (.04) so a rainbow forms at the pressed edge. When still, the film ripples gently at .004

options.trail: Share by which the first dot follows the cursor (per frame), default .5 — second .18 and third .1 are fixed
options.[data-fx-part=source]: Image, video or canvas shown behind the curtain (fit to the panel with cover) — if absent, filled with the skin color
options.--fx-tint · --fx-top · --fx-bottom · --f: (css variable) top, bottom and glow blob colors painted when there is no curtain tint or image

use: <section data-fx="glass-press-membrane" data-fx-glass-press-membrane="depth: .5; press: 1.45"><video data-fx-part="source" src="…" muted playsinline autoplay loop></video>…</section>

from.where: index.html .rw-stage (glass veil over the first section’s video, flowers and bee — the original is a three veil (44-cell plate, z 1.2, 1.25× screen) + transmission material (thickness .34 · roughness .07 · specular .04 · blur .1 · IOR 1.34), three cursor points .5 · .18 · .1, spring .055 · .9, press 1.45, less pressed near where the bee sits)

note: In the original, a curtain reflects a separately rendered three scene (drei transmission material), and once the bee flies out (flight .56→.88) the curtain clears (thickness .06 · roughness .012). The part lights the picture inside the panel with a single WebGL layer, without three. On devices without touch and with reduced motion, the curtain is not pressable and stays as frosted glass only
